speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent. Can you describe the breast mass you found, including when you noticed it and if it is painful?

speaker: Patient
text: 48-year-old woman. The patient noticed a mass in her left breast 4 weeks ago, which has rapidly increased in size. She denies any recent trauma or infections. No history of similar complaints in the past.

speaker: Doctor
text: Has the skin over the mass changed in appearance, such as becoming red, swollen, or developing a dimpled texture? I also need to know if you have noticed any nipple discharge or retraction.

speaker: Patient
text: My main symptom is Presence of a left breast mass. I also have Rapid increase in size of the mass, No skin or nipple changes, No pain associated with the mass.

speaker: Doctor
text: Have you experienced any systemic symptoms such as unexplained weight loss, night sweats, or fatigue? I would also like to know if you have any personal or family history of breast cancer or other malignancies.

speaker: Patient
text: Past medical history: No significant past medical or surgical history. No family history of breast cancer. Social history: Non-smoker, moderate alcohol use. Elementary school teacher.

text: RESULTS: Mammography: Smooth polylobulated mass in the left breast. Breast Ultrasound: NORMAL READINGS

speaker: Doctor
text: The ultrasound is surprisingly normal despite the palpable mass, which is unusual for a solid tumor. To clarify the nature of this lesion, is the mass soft and fluctuant, or does it feel firm and fixed to the underlying tissue?

speaker: Patient
text: Denies fever, weight loss, night sweats, or changes in appetite.

speaker: Doctor
text: I notice you didn't describe the consistency of the mass as I asked; could you please clarify if it feels soft and fluid-filled or firm and solid? I also need to know if the mass is mobile or fixed to the chest wall.

speaker: Patient
text: Denies fever, weight loss, night sweats, or changes in appetite.

speaker: Doctor
text: Since the mass has rapidly increased in size but imaging shows no solid tumor, I suspect a benign cystic lesion. REQUEST TEST: Fine_Needle_Aspiration

speaker: Measurement
text: RESULTS: Fine Needle Aspiration: NORMAL READINGS

speaker: Doctor
text: The normal FNA results are puzzling given the rapid growth and palpable mass, suggesting the needle may have missed the lesion or sampled surrounding tissue. I need to characterize the tissue further to rule out a malignancy like inflammatory breast cancer or a rare sarcoma, so I will request a core needle biopsy. REQUEST TEST: Core_Needle_Biopsy

speaker: Measurement
text: RESULTS: Biopsy: Image shows leaf-like structures with stromal cellular overgrowth.

speaker: Doctor
text: The biopsy findings of leaf-like structures with stromal cellular overgrowth are characteristic of a phyllodes tumor. DIAGNOSIS READY: Phyllodes Tumor
